name: What is the difference between window repair and full replacement for drafts?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between window repair and full replacement for drafts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Window repair typically addresses minor issues like re-caulking gaps, replacing weatherstripping, or fixing a broken pane. This is suitable if the window frame is still sound and the damage is isolated. Full replacement involves removing the entire window unit—frame and all—and installing a brand new one. Replacement is recommended when drafts are severe, frames are deteriorated, or energy efficiency is a primary concern, as it offers a complete solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair fixes minor issues like re-caulking, while full replacement installs a new window unit. Replacement is better for severe drafts or frame deterioration.
